children: An oil pipeline from Libya's Hamada and Tahara oilfields to Zawiya was reopened on Saturday, according to the head of the state-owned oil firm National Oil Corporation.
A pipeline valve was closed by individuals who entered the crude oil receiving station near the Zawiya refinery on Thursday, leading to a reduction in production at both fields.
